provenance.l: NASA STS-41 Mission Report: launch 279:11:47:14.983 GMT; Ulysses deployment 279:17:48:14; RCS separation burn 1 at 279:17:49:13, burn 2 not performed; Ulysses first burn 279:18:53:13
STS-41 press kit: orbit 160 x 160 nmi at 28.45 deg; spin-up to 70 rpm before the PAM-S firing; the deploy under the oversight of Tom Akers

AmericaSpace (2015, secondary): the aft frame of the IUS support structure tilted the stack to 29 deg, then to its 58 deg deployment position; the PAM-S spun Ulysses up to 70 rpm and made an 88-second burn
